availability.note: Live Alfa AU plug-in model page with 'Configure and Order' links on the research date. The configurator renders client-side and served no prices to automated fetches (/configurator-hub 404, /selector-pricing has empty msrp fields), so the grade count rests on CarExpert 9 Jul 2026 and Chasing Cars 9 Sep 2026 (https://www.chasingcars.com.au/news/new-car-prices/alfa-romeo-tonale-2027-italian-marque-addresses-compact-suvs-niggles-to-compete-with-bmw-x1-and-cupra-formentor/), which both list a single PHEV grade, Veloce Q4, with the Ti dropped. The model page's Veloce/Ti/Edizione Speciale trim cards and 60km/1.5L/208kW figures are stale pre-facelift content.

listPrice.note: CarExpert 9 Jul 2026 launch price table, all prices 'before on-road costs'. Same $78,990 before on-road costs in Chasing Cars 9 Sep 2026. Alfa AU site publishes no price; no later price change found.

batteryKwh.note: ADAC 'brutto 15,5 kWh, netto 12,0 kWh' for the facelift (ab 11/25) Plug-In 270 Q4, same powertrain as the AU Veloce Q4 (198kW/270hp). Held 12.9 had no source and is replaced. 15.5 gross matches CarExpert AU.

rangeKm.note: CarExpert AU spec table 'WLTP' 59km (article text says 58km; Chasing Cars says 54km claimed). Direction test: below the European WLTP best case of 67km on 235/50R18 (ADAC), consistent with the AU Veloce's larger wheels; accepted.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 12.0 / 59 x 100 = 20.3. ADAC's 12.3 kWh/100km is a utility-weighted WLTP figure, not EV-mode, and is not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: 59 + 42.5 L tank (ADAC Tankinhalt; CarExpert review rounds to 43 L) / 6.6 x 100 = 702.9, rounded 703.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: No published charge-sustaining figure. Australian tests: OnlineAuto up to 6.2 L/100km flat-battery loop; CarsGuide long-termer 7.0 and 6.1 L/100km in months of irregular charging (some EV running included, so true CS is higher). 6.6 sits between, and keeps sibling order by mass: Cupra Formentor VZe 6.5, BMW X1 xDrive25e 6.7, Mercedes GLA 250e 7.2.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: AU claimed combined 1.7 L/100km (also Chasing Cars), at or below 3.5. European WLTP 3.4 (ADAC) also passes. Price $78,990 is under both LCT thresholds regardless.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km. Tonale PHEV 39 g/km claimed (Chasing Cars).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 385L cargo capacity, PHEV with battery fitted; same in ADAC and OnlineAuto.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: ADAC labels 1,430L 'dachhoch' (to the roof), not the belt-line convention; no to-belt-line figure found (CarExpert review and OnlineAuto also quote 1,430L). Likely overstates vs convention.

seats.note: Five-seat SUV; no seven-seat version exists.

towKg.note: CarExpert AU spec table braked towing 1250kg; ADAC 'Anhängelast gebremst (12%)' 1250 kg.

warrantyYears.note: 5 years / unlimited km for vehicles registered from 22 April 2022; no servicing condition stated. Battery 8yr/160,000km per CarExpert.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to mercedes-gla-phev-250e ($78,000, 2150) and bmw-x1-phev-xdrive25e ($79,500, 2150) at the same price point; held value unchanged.

depreciationCurve.note: Aligned to the Alfa Romeo brand convention held on alfa-romeo-junior-elettrica (and Stellantis sibling jeep-avenger) per the one-convention-per-brand rule; replaces the held Tonale-only curve [1,0.63,0.5,0.41,0.34,0.29]. Below mainstream on documented evidence: 132 AU sales in 2025 and 53 in 2026 to October (https://atlas.carexpert.com.au/make/alfa-romeo/tonale), reported production end Nov 2027 (https://www.carscoops.com/2026/06/alfa-romeo-tonale-discontinuation/), US CarEdge 2-year residual ~45% (https://caredge.com/alfa-romeo/tonale/depreciation), which argues the steeper held curve was also defensible.

lowConfidence: alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.availability: Alfa AU configurator served no data; one-grade count rests on CarExpert Jul 2026 and Chasing Cars Sep 2026

alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.depreciationCurve: judged; aligned to brand convention, while Tonale-specific evidence (thin volume, production end 2027, US residuals) supports the steeper held curve
alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.rangeKm: AU sources disagree (54/58/59km); 59 taken from CarExpert's WLTP spec table
alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.fuelConsumptionL100km: judged from review real-world figures 6.1-7.0 L/100km
alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.bootLitresSeatsDown: 1,430L is to the roof per ADAC, not the belt-line convention
alfa-romeo-tonale-phev-veloce-q4.insuranceAnnual: judged, anchored to GLA 250e and X1 xDrive25e
